name: How long does it take to complete a finish carpentry project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a finish carpentry project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a finish carpentry project depends on its size and complexity. A small project, such as installing trim in a single room, might take a few days. Larger projects involving multiple rooms, custom built-ins, or intricate molding work could extend to several weeks. Factors like material availability, drying times for finishes, and coordination with other trades can also influence the timeline. Your contractor can provide a more precise schedule once the project details are finalized.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies; small trim jobs may take days, while larger projects with custom elements can take several weeks, depending on complexity and material availability.
